title: Rabbi David Tawil: Life Lessons From Pirke Abot- "The Connection of Giving"

summary: Rabbi Tawil discusses the connection between giving to others and experiencing personal happiness, emphasizing that meaningful, physical acts of kindness create deeper joy than impersonal donations. He explores the importance of hospitality and welcoming strangers, drawing on the example of Avraham Abinu in the Parasha to illustrate the value of treating all people with respect as creations of Hashem.
questions: Why does giving to others make us feel happy?
How can we make our charitable giving more meaningful?
What does it mean to be a hospitable person?
Why did Avraham Abinu leave his conversation with Hashem to greet strangers?
How should we treat people we encounter in our daily lives?
